items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: "she did not say yes or no to Al Capone or nobody."

ctx.x: Oh, sure, a specialty, yes. But Alma had a specialty. She had an act; she came out with a chair, selling furniture. "Anybody want to buy my chair?" She was a very Creole type, out of Buffalo, but she did not say yes or no to Al Capone or nobody. They fired us at rehearsal because they bought bassoon parts and everything for Basie's band to play for the show, following Earl Hines and Fletcher Henderson. And, no! But prior to that I had walked into the Grand Terrace with Mr. Basie, with no band, no job, no money…
You only played one night at the Grand Terrace? You didn't even play one night?
